test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ________ was the first bank to be fully managed by Indians.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab National Bank**__.

__
 
• **The first bank fully managed by Indians was Punjab National Bank, established in 1895 in Lahore**__.

 __
 
• Punjab National Bank not only survives to date but is also one of the largest banks in India.
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi
 
• Founder: Dyal Singh Majithia
 
• Founded: 19 May 1894, Lahore, Pakistan
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dena Bank** was a state-owned which **merged with Bank of Baroda in 2019**.

 
 
• It was headquartered in Mumbai and had 1,874 branches.
 
• The bank was established in 1938 and was nationalized by the Government of India in 1969.
 
 
 
• **Bank of India** is an Indian nationalized bank.
 
 
• It is owned by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, headquartered at Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai.
 
• Established in 1906, it has been owned by the government since nationalization in 1969.
 
 
 
• **Allahabad Bank** was an Indian nationalized bank headquartered in Kolkata, India.
 
 
• Established in Allahabad in 1865 and nationalized by the Government of India in 1969, the bank provided banking and financial services for 155 years, **until it was merged with Indian Bank in 2020**.
